NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: The researchers want to study a lavastone: let them, or refuse because some consider it sacred.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject), a researcher, has asked to study one of the elders' lavastones: weigh it, measure its glow, chip off a tiny piece. (friend), who believes lavastones are sacred, is appalled. The elders are split. What should they decide?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) studies the stone carefully, without chipping it, and learns that it is warmer at dawn and coolest at dusk, and that it glows brighter near the sea. It does not explain anything. It makes everyone more curious. (friend) watches every measurement, suspicious.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The elders refuse. (subject) is disappointed. (friend) is relieved. (subject) writes down everything people say about lavastones instead: the stories, the sightings, the healings. It becomes the most complete record on the island.
